column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: The desert buries\nwhat it takes, Isaac.{page_break}You cannot save\neveryone you follow.{end_wait}

You still think
there's time to save
everything.{page_break}Look at this place.
Some losses remain.{end_wait}
Keep following them.\nYou'll learn what it\ncosts to be too late.{end_wait}
